title: The fixture Library corpus names gitignored trial plates for its plates and images
body:
## Summary
app/(studio)/library/_port/fixtureCorpus.ts lands /trials/google/<style>/<scene>.jpg for every plate and about half of the images, and public/trials/**/*.jpg is gitignored, so a fresh clone's fixture Library draws those tiles broken.

## Description
fixtureCorpus.ts:166 (image, the non-deck half) and :177 (every plate) call fileBlob(`/trials/google/${style}/${scene}.jpg`). .gitignore:88 ignores /public/trials/**/*.jpg; this box holds only public/trials/index.json. The style atelier's fixture was moved off the same grid in f03cf366 under a test reading `git ls-files public` (tests/next-server/style-atelier.test.ts:52), and this round moved the kit (9f97feca); the corpus is the third copy of the rule and the only one left. Fixed looks like: each trial style lands its preset's tracked public/presets/<style>.jpg (the atelier's presetPlate), with the same git-tracked assertion over every fileBlob url the corpus mints.

## Flow
- open /library on the fixture side from a fresh clone
- corpus plates and forge images resolve to /trials/google/... -> 404
- tiles draw their media-problem face, or a blank picture

## Expected impact
Anyone running the fixture Library from a clone (CI screenshots, a second machine) sees most plates broken; the legibility and cx lanes photograph a Library that is not the operator's. Could break: the tile mix changes from per-scene pictures to one picture per style.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the fixture Library names only committed pictures
Before: every plate (quota ~1841 of 5000) and the non-deck half of ~850 images named untracked (walked from fixtureCorpus.ts:157-177; not counted by instrument)
After: 0 untracked under a git-ls-files case over the corpus's urls
Method: simulation - the instrument is the atelier test's shape; the file is another context's (library port), so this round did not build it
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a tests/next-server case: build the fixture corpus, collect every fileBlob url, assert each is in `git ls-files public` (style-atelier.test.ts:52 is the model); seed red on HEAD, then move plates/images to presetPlate

title: The ScheduleForm specimen's refusal names a slot its own data does not hold
body:
## Summary
FloorKit's ScheduleForm refusal says chokepoint is on youtube in slot s5, scheduled for 2026-10-16T12:00; the specimen's own s5 is failed at 2026-10-13T18:00, and a failed slot holds nothing.

## Description
app/(studio)/kit/FloorKit.tsx:203 refusal="video:export:chokepoint is already on youtube (slot s5, scheduled for 2026-10-16T12:00:00.000Z)". SLOTS s5 (FloorKit.tsx:44) is { status: failed, publishAt: 2026-10-13T18:00 }. The engine writes this sentence from the HOLDING slot (packages/kernel/src/slots/core.ts:83-87 clashOf/clashText, SLOT_HOLDS), so the specimen shows a refusal no engine could produce over its own rail. Fixed: the refusal is clashText over a slot in SLOTS that holds the item (add libraryItemId to a scheduled slot, or schedule the item the refusal names).

## Flow
- open /kit#floor, read the ScheduleForm error line
- find slot s5 in the calendar specimen beside it: failed, 13 Oct 18:00
- the two disagree on state and time

## Expected impact
A designer checking the refusal's wording against the rail reads two facts that cannot both be true. Could break: nothing outside the specimen.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the specimen's refusal is one its rail could produce
Before: 1 of 1 refusal names a slot whose state (scheduled vs failed) and time (16 Oct 12:00 vs 13 Oct 18:00) disagree with SLOTS
After: 0 disagreements under a case that parses the refusal and finds its slot in SLOTS holding the item
Method: probe - read the literal against SLOTS; the instrument (a kit-sheet case) is unbuilt and the fix needs a fixture decision (which slot holds which item)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
app/(studio)/kit/FloorKit.tsx:44 slot("s5", "Chokepoint explainer", "2026-10-13T18:00:00.000Z", "failed", ...)
app/(studio)/kit/FloorKit.tsx:203 refusal="... (slot s5, scheduled for 2026-10-16T12:00:00.000Z)"
packages/kernel/src/slots/core.ts:86 clashText = `${item} is already on ${channel} (slot ${c.id}, ${c.state} for ${c.at})`
instrument: kit-sheet case: render FloorSection, parse `slot (\w+), (\w+) for (\S+)` from the ErrorLine, require that slot in SLOTS with that status and publishAt and a holding state

title: AudioKit inlines a one-second WAV data URL where a quarter second plays the same
body:
## Summary
AudioKit's SILENCE is 8,044 bytes of PCM base64'd into a ~10.7 KB data URL, rendered twice in /kit's server HTML.

## Description
app/(studio)/kit/AudioKit.tsx:49-74 silentWav(): rate 8000, n = rate (one second). Every displayed duration comes from props (durationS / lengthS), not the file, so the length buys nothing a 0.25 s file would not; the AudioSection's server render is 143,583 bytes of which ~21.4 KB is the two inlined copies (renderToStaticMarkup, this round).

## Flow
- GET /kit
- AudioPreview and the RoundTrip download inline SILENCE into the HTML
- two ~10.7 KB attributes per page load

## Expected impact
/kit's HTML shrinks by ~16 KB; nobody outside the kit notices. Could break: a browser that refuses a very short WAV (none known at 2,000 samples).

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - smaller /kit HTML
Before: 2 x ~10.7 KB data URLs in a 143.6 KB AudioSection render
After: predicted 2 x ~2.7 KB at n = rate / 4
Method: probe - Before measured by renderToStaticMarkup; After computed, not rendered; play control untested in a browser
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
app/(studio)/kit/AudioKit.tsx:50-51 const rate = 8000; const n = rate;
renderToStaticMarkup(AudioSection): 143583 bytes, 2 x data:audio/wav
instrument: renderToStaticMarkup(AudioSection).length on both arms, plus tests/live kit audio play in Chromium for the short file

title: StyleKit's ref() falls back to the first file for a name it does not list
body:
## Summary
ref() keys a blob by FILES.indexOf(file); a miss gives -1, whose sha parses back to index 0, so a wrong name would draw the first picture silently.

## Description
app/(studio)/kit/StyleKit.tsx ref/srcOf. After 9f97feca every ref names one of the four FILES entries.

## Flow
- n/a

## Expected impact
None reachable.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - a missing name fails loudly
Before: 0 of 9 refs miss
After: 0 of 9 refs miss
Method: probe - walked every ref() call
Result: not-better
Gate: none
evidence: StyleKit.tsx: plate(_) -> ref(PLATE); EXEMPLARS -> ref of 3 listed presets
